# Craft CV

CV builder with AI Optimize and 16 rule-based ATS checks. Free, open source, no account required.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4
- **State Management**: Zustand (local-first)
- **PDF Generation**: @react-pdf/renderer
- **Deployment**: Docker, Traefik, VPS (Ubuntu)

## Core Philosophy
- **Privacy First**: Editor CV data is saved in browser localStorage. No central CV database. AI features and ATS analysis send content through the server for processing; aggregate counters are saved server-side.
- **ATS Optimization**: Single-column PDFs with selectable text, plus 16 deterministic lint checks. A separate best-effort AI review does not reproduce a proprietary ATS or predict hiring decisions.
- **AI-Powered**: AI Optimize compares proposed edits against existing CV details and flags unsupported additions. Structured name, email, phone and profile-link fields are masked in the standard editor flow; free text and chat may contain identifiers. PDF Import, ATS review and TL;DR generation do not use this masking or patch-grounding pipeline.

## Key Features
- **Live PDF Preview**: Real-time, paginated PDF preview matching the export.
- **AI Optimize**: Chat-based CV improvements based on job descriptions.
- **AI Diff View**: Review proposed edits, flags and protected-date changes. All flagged proposals route APPLY through this modal; metrics flagged as new require confirmation before applying.
- **Keyword Gap**: AI extracts job keywords; code matches them against CV text.
- **Analytics**: GTM-configured measurement, including GA4 and Clarity; consent settings are managed in deployment.
- **Privacy policy**: https://craftcv.online/privacy
- **Local Import/Export**: Save and load CV data as JSON files.

## Project Structure
The project follows a standard Next.js App Router organization:
- **Routing & Pages**: Main entry points for Home, Editor, and Preview functionality.
- **AI Integration**: Server-side logic for CV optimization and AI interaction.
- **UI Components**: Reusable interface elements and specialized editor forms.
- **State & Logic**: Global state management and utility functions for data handling.

## Data Structure
The CV is managed as a unified JSON object following a standardized schema for Personal Info, Experience, Education, Skills, and Projects.
